title: Style Editor Row/Column Enhancements and Bug Fixes

items.description: Add additional layout options to Row and Column elements including height: auto, grid cols, grid rows, and ensure all flexbox attributes are fully implemented
stepsToVerify: Open Style Editor and select a Row or Column element
Verify height: auto option is available and functional
Verify grid cols and grid rows options are available when applicable
Verify all flexbox attributes (flex-direction, flex-wrap, flex-grow, flex-shrink, flex-basis) are configurable
Verify changes reflect correctly in both preview and PDF export

items.category: Style Editor - Row Margins for Gaps
items.description: Add margin controls exclusive to Row elements to enable per-row gap spacing
stepsToVerify: Open Style Editor and select a Row element
Verify margin controls (top, right, bottom, left) are available for Row elements
Set different margin values and verify gaps appear correctly between rows
Verify margin changes reflect in both preview and PDF export

items.description: Fix row and grid borders that appear to overlap each other in the style editor, making them hard to distinguish
stepsToVerify: Create nested Row and Column containers with visible borders
Verify borders are clearly distinguishable and don't visually overlap
Verify border rendering is consistent between parent and child containers
Test with various border widths and colors

items.category: Style Editor Bug - Justify Content in Row
items.description: Fix justify-content property not working correctly in Row elements
stepsToVerify: Create a Row element with multiple child elements
Test justify-content: flex-start - verify children align to start
Test justify-content: flex-end - verify children align to end
Test justify-content: center - verify children are centered
Test justify-content: space-between - verify children spread with space between
Test justify-content: space-around - verify children have equal space around
Test justify-content: space-evenly - verify children have equal space distribution
Verify all values work correctly in both preview and PDF export
